value: Thermostat fan switch in Auto with a call (or On): thermostat energizes indoor fan relay F, which starts the indoor fan motor IDM.
Cool call, zone above setpoint: thermostat Y closes. Compressor contactor CC1 coil energizes as long as LPC1, HPC1 and discharge line thermostat TDL1 are all closed.
CC1 contacts close: compressor CPR1 and outdoor fan motor ODM start.
No microprocessor: any safety opening drops CC1 immediately, and the compressor restarts as soon as that switch recloses. No lockout, no timer, no diagnostics.
Cool satisfied: Y opens, CC1 drops; fan relay F drops when the call ends (Auto).

cooling-95F.note: Representative healthy-unit readings at 95°F OA / 75°F RA. Not Trane charging-chart values.

readings.txt_tstat: Thermostat: Cool, setpoint 73°F, space 75°F. Y1 and G energized.
readings.txt_controller: No unit controller on this unit (electromechanical). Nothing to read but the thermostat and the safeties.
readings.txt_look_unit: Unit running. Compressor steady, outdoor fan spinning, blower running.
readings.txt_look_condenser: Coil reasonably clean. Fan turning, warm discharge air.
readings.txt_look_evap: Filters average. Coil sweating evenly. Belt OK.
readings.txt_look_economizer: Damper about 20% open. Linkage tight. Mixed air sensor downstream of the dampers, ahead of filters.
readings.txt_manual_stroke: Damper strokes freely through full travel by hand.
readings.txt_jade_checkout: DAMPER OPEN: actuator drives full open, blades follow. DAMPER CLOSE: drives closed, blades seal.
